title: Learning to Explain: Supervised Token Attribution from Transformer Attention Patterns
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion. Its focus is on the general performance of an explainable AI method for transformer models.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
